articles.title: Congress leaders ahead of Southern Zonal Council meeting - Prokerala
articles.full_text: Chennai: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar with Kerala Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan, Telangana Deputy Chief Minister Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka, Telangana Agriculture Minister Thummala Nageswara Rao and Karnataka Home Minister Priyank Kharge ahead of the 31st Southern Zonal Council meeting in Tamil Nadu on Thursday, August 20, 2026.
